capabilities: Record dual-channel system audio and microphone
Sync Google Calendar and show a meeting agenda sidebar
Transcribe recordings with on-device Whisper or a remote endpoint
Generate AI-enriched meeting notes and summaries
Manage a meetings dashboard and recording retention
disambiguation: Not a general AI assistant; it only handles meeting recording, transcription, calendar agendas, and meeting notes.
extras: macOS 13.3+ on Apple Silicon and Obsidian Desktop only; downloads a native recorder helper, whisper.cpp runtime, and models on first use (checksum-verified, pinned to the plugin version); no telemetry or server of its own; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: It vendors and adapts code from the projects below — you do not need to install them separately.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record meetings, transcribe them, and turn them into enriched notes, so users must juggle separate recording, transcription, and calendar tools.

relations.evidence: Dual-channel ScreenCaptureKit recorder (swift-helper/), Google Calendar integration, and parts of the core plugin scaffolding
Meeting agenda view (day grouping, meeting rows, status header, date picker, and related UI/styles)
on-device Whisper transcription runs in Meeting Copilot's own system-recorder Swift helper (whisper.cpp over Metal)

requires.name: AI command-line tool (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or pi)

summary: Meeting transcription and note-taking plugin for macOS that records dual-channel audio, syncs Google Calendar, transcribes, and writes AI-summarized notes.
